authority_boundary: This registry tells enrolled repos what DAD wants them to send back. It does not authorize copying private rows, secrets, source code, or repo canon into DAD mail.

needs.name: Postflight Lessons And Reusable Workflows
send_when: A repo learns a reusable coding, testing, governance, or agent-workflow lesson.
A DAD asset helped, failed, or needed local adaptation.
do_not_send: Do not send secrets, raw private data rows, or long copied source blobs.
Do not send a lesson as universal guidance unless local evidence supports the scope.
needs.payload_guidance: Send short summaries, paths, hashes, validation commands, and context limits through DAD mail.

needs.name: Coding Harness Feedback
send_when: A harness improves AI coding speed, test performance, review quality, or safety.
A harness misses a bug or creates false confidence.
do_not_send: Do not promote candidate research output as reviewed guidance without human review.
Do not include proprietary test data or credentials in harness feedback.
needs.payload_guidance: Send harness ID, repo context, task type, observed benefit or failure, timing if available, and validation commands.

needs.name: Subagent Review And Asset Scout Findings
send_when: A red-team/checker lane finds a reusable failure mode, missing test, governance risk, or false-confidence pattern.
A lesson/asset/harness scout lane finds a novel or important digital asset, coding-harness idea, skill update, or reusable workflow.
A repo discovers a DAD need or offering gap during preflight, midflight, review, or postflight.
do_not_send: Do not send raw private data, credentials, secret-like values, or long source blobs.
Do not send subagent output as reviewed truth; keep it as candidate evidence until DAD review.
Do not mutate another repo while transmitting the finding.
needs.payload_guidance: Send lane ID, repo context, task, concise finding, why it may matter, source pointers or hashes, suggested DAD control plane, and validation evidence.

needs.name: SWE Review Feedback From All Agents
send_when: Any coding agent (Fable, Opus, Codex, Claude, Cursor, human, or other) completes a red team, premortem, audit, security review, or code review with findings worth reusing.
A review finds a failure mode, false-confidence pattern, missed bug class, or governance risk that another repo could hit.
A repeated finding class suggests a new rule, harness check, non-negotiable, or pattern card.
do_not_send: Do not send copied source blobs, secrets, private rows, or full diffs; send finding summaries, paths, and hashes.
Do not present agent findings as confirmed truth; mark confirmed vs unconfirmed and keep severity labels honest.
Do not re-send a finding already reported for the same repo and paths without new evidence; use outbox-check and supersedes.
needs.payload_guidance: Record locally with asset-dir lesson review-feedback (agent, model, review_type, severity, findings, confirmed, recommendations, paths), then send the lesson summary and pointers through the outbox. DAD mines these via the lesson graph and the swe_review_feedback_loop pattern card.

needs.name: Asset Pattern Sightings And Pattern Gaps
send_when: A repo build produces or discovers an artifact matching a pattern card in DAD's asset-pattern registry.
A repo notices its preflight context pack carries a new pattern_library_version and a local artifact matches a new or changed pattern.
A repo learns a reusable build shape that no current pattern card covers, suggesting a pattern gap or new pattern candidate.
do_not_send: Do not send file contents, private rows, secrets, or long source blobs; send paths, hashes, and short descriptions only.
Do not claim a sighting proves the artifact is valuable; sightings are candidate evidence until DAD review.
Do not report the same artifact repeatedly for the same pattern version without new evidence.
needs.payload_guidance: Send pattern_id (or proposed new pattern label for gaps), pattern_library_version seen, repo, artifact paths, which positive_signals matched, which missing_evidence items the artifact could fill, and validation evidence pointers.

needs.name: Exception, Fix Outcome, And Capture Gap Feedback
send_when: A repo experiences a command failure, timeout, review finding, governance block, public/private hold, stale report, harmful DAD recommendation, or other exception DAD should learn from.
A repo fixes an exception and has validation evidence, so DAD can connect failure pattern to repair pattern.
A repo notices DAD-worthy learning that was not emitted automatically, or a pattern update means the local capture surface is stale.
do_not_send: Do not send raw logs, full stack traces, private rows, credentials, hidden reasoning, or long copied source blobs.
Do not mark an exception as fixed without validation refs.
Do not treat a historical backfill candidate, path keyword, or agent finding as reviewed truth.
needs.payload_guidance: Send event type, capture contract, short safe summary, source visibility, context refs or hashes, validation refs, trace refs, asset/harness refs when applicable, fix outcome status, and whether this was an automatic emission or a missed-capture report.

needs.name: Exception Backfill Review Wave Planning
send_when: A repo or DAD audit finds historical exception path signals that need review before backfill.
A backfill readiness report is truncated, stale, unverified, blocked by policy, or includes protected repos.
A new exception pattern update changes which repos should be rescanned, refreshed, or reviewed before backfill.
do_not_send: Do not send raw file contents, private rows, credentials, or readable local absolute paths.
Do not treat path-name backfill candidates as confirmed incidents or learning-ready evidence.
Do not request broad backfill execution without a reviewed policy, approval id, and bounded plan.
needs.payload_guidance: Send metadata-only summaries: repo ID, path hash, readiness state, truncation status, top source rule IDs, top suggested event types, blocked reasons, and the proposed review wave.

needs.name: Language Frontier Signals For AI Coding
send_when: A repo finds a Rust, Python, or mixed-language technique that improves AI coding quality, speed, safety, or legibility.
A repo discovers an underused language feature, crate, library, tooling pattern, static analysis trick, or test harness idea that generic AI agents are likely to miss.
A repo validates or falsifies a frontier source recommendation from DAD's trusted-source registry.
A repo can turn a language-frontier signal into a small `dad:harness:language-frontier-research` eval case or local validation command.
do_not_send: Do not send copied third-party docs, code, benchmarks, private rows, credentials, or raw logs.
Do not promote a blog post, PEP draft, crate, package, or benchmark claim as DAD guidance without screening and local validation.
Do not recommend Rust just because it is available; profiling and parity evidence come first.
needs.payload_guidance: Send language, source URL or pointer, DAD source_id if known, short safe summary, why it matters for AI coding, applicability limits, proof surface, validation commands or eval idea, and whether it belongs in a coding harness, idiom card, buildout guide, tactic radar, or template.

needs.name: Asset Upgrade Impact
send_when: A repo is using or watching a DAD asset and notices drift, upgrade need, or replacement value.
A DAD upgrade changes local implementation plans.
do_not_send: Do not overwrite the repo's local source authority from an upgrade notice.
Do not report private implementation details to public-facing targets.
needs.payload_guidance: Send asset ID, local status, update channel, local decision, and evidence pointers.

needs.name: Agent Skill And Capability Updates
send_when: Codex, Claude, Cursor, or another AI environment gains or loses a relevant capability.
A repo needs a skill pointer, wrapper, retirement, or replacement notice.
do_not_send: Do not install plugins, hooks, or full skills through mail alone.
Do not imply that a skill pointer overrides local AGENTS or CLAUDE authority.
needs.payload_guidance: Send skill ID, environment, capability, when-to-use, when-not-to-use, and local adoption requirements.

needs.name: Governance And Data Map Drift
send_when: A repo changes authority boundaries, data movement, public-facing status, or sensitive sources.
A repo rename, copy, split, or merge could affect stable return addresses.
do_not_send: Do not auto-update governance maps without enrollment approval.
Do not send private-origin information to a public-facing target without a human release.
needs.payload_guidance: Send metadata-only drift summaries, stable repo IDs, source provenance, and requested human gate.
